items.desc_en: Ukraine will get access to OpenAI's advanced GPT 5.6 Sol model under the deal - a rival to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable
items.desc_zh: 根据协议，乌克兰将获得 OpenAI 先进的 GPT 5.6 Sol 模型 - Anthropic 的 Mythos 和 Fable 的竞争对手

items.title_en: Tigray forces seize main airport in northern Ethiopia from police, residents tell the BBC
items.title_zh: 居民告诉英国广播公司，提格雷部队从警方手中夺取了埃塞俄比亚北部的主要机场
items.desc_en: There are fears of a return to war in the northern region as tensions between the government and TPLF escalate.
items.desc_zh: 随着政府和蒂格雷人阵之间的紧张局势升级，人们担心北部地区会再次爆发战争。

items.title_en: Pornhub investigated over its age checks
items.title_zh: Pornhub 对其年龄检查进行调查
items.desc_en: The regulator says it has concerns over how the site is relying on third party checks provided by Apple for some users.
items.desc_zh: 监管机构表示，对该网站如何依赖苹果公司为某些用户提供的第三方检查感到担忧。

items.title_en: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
items.title_zh: 南非一住宅发生大规模枪击事件 11人死亡
items.desc_en: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.
items.desc_zh: 警方称，其中一名死者据信是一名孕妇。

items.title_en: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
items.title_zh: 联合国机构发现加沙暴力侵害妇女行为的报告激增
items.desc_en: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.
items.desc_zh: 联合国人口基金还表示，早婚和强迫婚姻的数量“严重增加”。

items.title_en: US criticises Australia's proposed algorithm opt-out laws as 'censorship'
items.title_zh: 美国批评澳大利亚提出的算法选择退出法是“审查制度”
items.desc_en: Under the draft laws, tech firms face fines if they do not give users the option to switch off algorithms.
items.desc_zh: 根据该法律草案，科技公司如果不向用户提供关闭算法的选项，将面临罚款。

items.title_en: Playing loud music on the bus? That will cost you hundreds of dollars in Singapore
items.title_zh: 在公交车上大声播放音乐？在新加坡这将花费你数百美元
items.desc_en: Authorities are cracking down on "disruptive behaviours" including eating onboard and putting feet on seats.
items.desc_zh: 当局正在严厉打击“破坏性行为”，包括在机上饮食和把脚放在座位上。

items.title_en: Will a switch to light speed cut power use at data centres?
items.title_zh: 改用光速会减少数据中心的用电量吗？
items.desc_en: To save power and add capacity,  data centres are switching from copper wires to tech using light.
items.desc_zh: 为了节省电力和增加容量，数据中心正在从铜线转向使用光技术。

items.title_en: A new skyline of data centres is rising from the rolling plains of rural China
items.title_zh: 数据中心的新天际线正在中国农村连绵起伏的平原上拔地而起
items.desc_en: Potato farmers rub shoulders with rows of gleaming new data centres as Trump and Xi meet to discuss AI safety.
items.desc_zh: 当特朗普和习近平会面讨论人工智能安全时，马铃薯农民与一排排闪闪发光的新数据中心擦肩而过。

items.title_en: Rare look at the remote engine rooms powering China's AI ambitions
items.title_zh: 罕见地看到为中国人工智能雄心提供动力的远程机房
items.desc_en: The BBC is in Inner Mongolia where dozen of Chinese data centres are being constructed, as the country aims to lead the world in artificial intelligence.
items.desc_zh: BBC在内蒙古正在建设数十个中国数据中心，中国的目标是在人工智能领域引领世界。
